title: Before the Phenomenon: The Earliest Known Printing of Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
description: The galley sheets printed at Bloomsbury on 25 February 1997 — the only known surviving copy of the earliest printing in any form.

story_body.text: In February 1997, a small London publisher printed the galley sheets for a first novel by an unknown author. Bloomsbury's initial U.K. print run would run to only 500 copies, mostly sent to libraries. Nobody involved yet knew what they were holding — this was still just a manuscript proof making its way toward print, months before the world had any reason to know the name Harry Potter.
